summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc., a Canadian pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K with an attached Sales Agreement dated August 14, 2026, with Leerink Partners LLC as agent. The agreement establishes an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program permitting the company to issue and sell up to $50,000,000 of its common shares in the United States from time to time. No specific shares were sold under this filing, and the agreement merely sets the framework for potential future placements. The program is subject to a registration statement filed August 11, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising mechanism with no special-situations characteristics such as a tender, acquisition, or restructuring. Watch for subsequent placement notices and actual sales for capital-raising activity.
